:::{#def-moment}
#### Raw moment

The **$k$-th raw moment** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$,
for a [positive integer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/number-systems.html#def-positive-integer) $k$
with $\E{\abs{X}^k} < \infty$,
is the [expectation](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) of $X^k$:

$$\E{X^k}$$

:::
